name: @jobleft/shell
description: The desktop shell (Tauri v2, Electron as the fallback). It starts the local server and opens the UI.

scripts.app:build: node scripts/pack.ts && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/cargo-target" node "$(ls -d ../../node_modules/.pnpm/@tauri-apps+cli@*/node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli | tail -1)/tauri.js" build --debug --bundles app
